suite.name: 01 Baseline Problem

test.name: Baseline Thread Logging Is Broken

kw.name: Run Worker Baseline
kw.doc: Spawn ``count`` worker threads using the plain Python threading API. Each worker logs using Robot Framework's public logger.

test.doc: Three worker threads try to log 3 messages each. The log should only show the MainThread messages.

suite.doc: Reproduces the out-of-the-box thread-logging problem. Messages logged from threading.Thread workers are dropped by robot.output.librarylogger.write.
